name: web_reg_save_param
signature: int web_reg_save_param(const char *ParamName, <List of Attributes>, LAST);
description: Registers a request to save dynamic data from the server response to a parameter, by searching for text between case-sensitive left (LB) and right (RB) boundaries. The C version of this function is marked deprecated in the documentation; use web_reg_save_param_ex or web_reg_save_param_xpath instead.

args.name: ParamName
args.desc: The name of the output parameter to create.

args.name: LB
args.desc: The left boundary, required; case-sensitive.

args.name: RB
args.desc: The right boundary, required; case-sensitive.

args.name: ORD
args.desc: The occurrence number to save, or "All" for a parameter array.

args.name: Search
args.desc: The search scope: Headers, Body, Noresource, or ALL (default).

args.name: Convert
args.desc: Converts the result: HTML_TO_URL or HTML_TO_TEXT.

args.name: IgnoreRedirections
args.desc: Yes/No: ignores redirect responses.

args.name: SaveOffset
args.desc: The starting position of the substring to save.

args.name: SaveLen
args.desc: The length of the substring to save.

args.name: NOTFOUND
args.desc: "error" (default) or "warning" if the data is not found.

example:
web_reg_save_param("SessionId",
    "LB=name=\"sid\" value=\"",
    "RB=\"",
    "Ord=1",
    "Search=Body",
    LAST);

web_url("home",
    "URL=http://localhost/WebTours/",
    "Resource=0",
    "Mode=HTML",
    LAST);

lr_output_message("SessionId = %s", lr_eval_string("{SessionId}"));

name: web_reg_save_param_ex
signature: int web_reg_save_param_ex("ParamName=<output parameter name>", [LB[/IC][BIN]=<value>,] [RB[/IC][BIN]=<value>,] <list of attributes>, SEARCH FILTERS, LAST);
description: Registers a request to capture dynamic data from the server response between a left and a right boundary and save it to a parameter for correlation. Supports parameter arrays through Ordinal=All (the number of results is available in {ParamName_count}); the boundaries themselves are not saved.

args.name: ParamName
args.desc: The name of the output parameter to create.

args.name: LB
args.desc: The left boundary where data capture begins.

args.name: RB
args.desc: The right boundary where data capture ends.

args.name: /IC
args.desc: Boundary matching is not case-sensitive (for example, LB/IC=...).

args.name: /BIN
args.desc: The boundary is written in binary escape format.

args.name: Ordinal
args.desc: The occurrence to save: a number, "All", or "RANDOM".

args.name: SEARCH_FILTERS
args.desc: Filters that narrow the search scope (for example, Scope=body).

args.name: LAST
args.desc: The required marker for the end of the argument list.

name: web_reg_save_param_regexp
signature: int web_reg_save_param_regexp("ParamName=<output parameter name>", "RegExp=<regular_expression>", ["Group=<0-10>",] List of Attributes, [SEARCH FILTERS,] LAST);
description: Registers a request to capture dynamic data that matches a regular expression (PERL-compatible) and save it to a parameter. Can save the entire match or a specific capture group; it is not recorded automatically, so it must be added manually.

args.name: ParamName
args.desc: The name of the output parameter to create.

args.name: RegExp
args.desc: A PERL-compatible regular expression with up to 10 capture groups.

args.name: Group
args.desc: The part to save: 0 (the entire match) or 1-10 (a capture group); default 1.

args.name: Ordinal
args.desc: Attribute: "All" produces a parameter array.

args.name: SEARCH_FILTERS
args.desc: Filters that narrow the search scope (for example, RequestUrl).

args.name: LAST
args.desc: The required marker for the end of the argument list.

example: web_reg_save_param_regexp( "ParamName=Correlation1", "RegExp=]+>(.+)", "Ordinal=All", SEARCH_FILTERS, "RequestUrl=*/files/index.html", LAST);

name: web_reg_save_param_xpath
signature: int web_reg_save_param_xpath("ParamName=<output parameter name>", "QueryString=<Xpath>", ["ReturnXML=<Yes|No>",] ["SelectAll=<Yes|No>",] <List of Attributes>, <Search Filters>, LAST);
description: Registers a request to save dynamic data from an XML/HTML-formatted buffer to a parameter using an XPath expression. With SelectAll=Yes, all matches are saved as an array (ParamName_1, ParamName_2, ...; the count is in {ParamName_count}).

args.name: ParamName
args.desc: The name of the output parameter to create.

args.name: QueryString
args.desc: The XPath expression that points to the value to save.

args.name: ReturnXML
args.desc: Yes: returns the entire XML node including its children; No (default): returns only the element value.

args.name: SelectAll
args.desc: Yes: saves all matches as an array.

args.name: SEARCH_FILTERS
args.desc: Filters that narrow the search scope (for example, Scope=Body).

args.name: LAST
args.desc: The required marker for the end of the argument list.

name: web_reg_save_param_json
signature: int web_reg_save_param_json("ParamName=<output parameter name>", "QueryString=<json query>", ["SelectAll=<Yes|No>",] <List of Attributes>, <Search Filters>, LAST);
description: Registers a request to find and retrieve dynamic data from a JSON-formatted response using a JSONPath expression, and save it to a parameter. With SelectAll=Yes, all matches are saved as an indexed array (ParamName_1, ... and ParamName_count).

args.name: ParamName
args.desc: The name of the output parameter; created if it does not exist.

args.name: QueryString
args.desc: The JSONPath expression for the value to retrieve.

args.name: SelectAll
args.desc: Yes: saves all matches as an indexed array.

args.name: SEARCH_FILTERS
args.desc: Filters that narrow the search scope (for example, Scope=Body).

args.name: LAST
args.desc: The required marker for the end of the argument list.

example:
web_reg_save_param_json(
    "ParamName=nameParam",
    "QueryString=$..arguments.additional_context[0].name",
    SEARCH_FILTERS,
    "Scope=Body",
    LAST);

web_url("127.0.0.1:12800",
    "URL=http://127.0.0.1:12800/",
    "Resource=1",
    "RecContentType=application/json",
    "Referer=",
    "Snapshot=t1.inf",
    LAST);

web_url("127.0.0.1:12800_2",
    "URL=http://127.0.0.1:12800/?name={nameParam}",
    "Resource=1",
    "RecContentType=application/json",
    "Referer=",
    "Snapshot=t4.inf",
    LAST);

name: web_reg_save_param_attrib
signature: int web_reg_save_param_attrib("ParamName=<output parameter name>", TagName=<value>, Extract=<value>, [Name=<value>, ] [Id=<value>, ] [Class=<value>, ] [Type=<value>, ]<List of Attributes>, <SEARCH FILTERS>,LAST );
description: Registers a request to save dynamic data from an HTML-formatted response to a parameter, based on the tag and attributes of an HTML element. Useful for retrieving values such as hidden form fields without left/right boundaries.

args.name: ParamName
args.desc: The name of the output parameter to create.

args.name: TagName
args.desc: The HTML element name (for example, input, div).

args.name: Extract
args.desc: The HTML attribute whose value is saved (for example, value, innerHTML).

args.name: Name
args.desc: Filters by the element's name attribute.

args.name: Id
args.desc: Filters by the element's id attribute.

args.name: Class
args.desc: Filters by the element's class attribute.

args.name: Type
args.desc: Filters by the element type (for example, hidden).

example:
web_reg_save_param_attrib(
    "ParamName=corrparam1",
    "TagName=input",
    "Extract=value",
    "Name=field1",
    "Type=*",
    SEARCH_FILTERS,
    "IgnoreRedirections=No",
    LAST);

web_reg_save_param_attrib(
    "ParamName=corrparam2",
    "TagName=p",
    "Extract=innerHTML",
    "Name=field2",
    "Id=*",
    SEARCH_FILTERS,
    "IgnoreRedirections=No",
    LAST);

name: web_reg_find
signature: int web_reg_find( const char *attribute_list_, LAST );
description: Registers a search for a text string in an HTML page, performed when the next action function is called, to verify that the correct page was received. By default it fails if the text is not found; the number of matches can be saved with SaveCount.

args.name: Text
args.desc: The text string to search for (required unless TextPfx/TextSfx is used).

args.name: TextPfx
args.desc: The left boundary: text that precedes the search string.

args.name: TextSfx
args.desc: The right boundary: text that follows the search string.

args.name: Search
args.desc: The scope: Headers, Body, Noresource, or ALL (default BODY).

args.name: SaveCount
args.desc: The name of the parameter in which to store the number of matches.

args.name: Fail
args.desc: "Found" or "NotFound" (default): the condition treated as a failure.

args.name: ID
args.desc: An identifier string used to associate the check with the log.

args.name: RelFrameId
args.desc: The relative frame ID (for example, 1.2).

name: web_global_verification
signature: int web_global_verification( <List of Attributes>, LAST );
description: Registers a search for specific text on all subsequent requests until paused (web_global_verification_pause). Unlike web_reg_find, which applies to a single action function; useful for detecting application-level errors that are not reflected in the HTTP status code.

args.name: Text
args.desc: The text string to search for (not empty).

args.name: TextPfx
args.desc: The left boundary of the text (used without Text).

args.name: TextSfx
args.desc: The right boundary of the text (used without Text).

args.name: Search
args.desc: The location: Headers, Body, NORESOURCE (default), or All.

args.name: Fail
args.desc: "Found" (default, fails if the text appears) or "NotFound" (fails if the text is absent).

args.name: ID
args.desc: An identifier string used with pause/resume.

name: web_global_verification_pause
signature: int web_global_verification_pause(const char *ID [, const char *ID1, ..., const char *IDn], LAST);
description: Temporarily suspends the checks registered by web_global_verification until web_global_verification_resume is called with the same ID.

args.name: ID
args.desc: A name-value pair "ID=..." identical to the ID argument of web_global_verification; more than one can be given.

args.name: LAST
args.desc: The required marker for the end of the argument list.

name: web_global_verification_resume
signature: int web_global_verification_resume( const char *ID [, const char *ID1_, ..., const char *IDn_], LAST);
description: Resumes checks that were previously suspended by web_global_verification_pause, based on the ID given in web_global_verification.

args.name: ID
args.desc: A name-value pair "ID=..." previously given to web_global_verification, for example "ID=id1","ID=id2".

args.name: LAST
args.desc: The required marker for the end of the argument list.

name: web_save_header
signature: int web_save_header(const char *type, const char *param);
description: Saves the request or response headers to a parameter, with each header separated by "\r\n" or "\n". Each new request overwrites the parameter value; pass an empty string "" as param to stop saving. Does not capture additional requests (images/frames) and is not supported in scripts with concurrent groups.

args.name: type
args.desc: The header type: REQUEST or RESPONSE.

args.name: param
args.desc: The name of the parameter in which the header is saved.

name: web_save_param_length
signature: int web_save_param_length( const char *Param_, const char *Base_, LAST );
description: Creates a new parameter named "<Param_>_Length" that holds the length of an existing parameter's value, in Decimal or Hexadecimal format.

args.name: Param_
args.desc: The name of the parameter whose value length is to be saved.

args.name: Base_
args.desc: The number format of the result: "Base=Decimal" or "Base=Hexadecimal".

name: web_save_timestamp_param
signature: int web_save_timestamp_param( const char *tmstampParam, LAST );
description: Saves the local timestamp of the computer running the script to a parameter, as the number of milliseconds since January 1, 1970. The value cannot be stored as an integer; it is usually generated automatically by VuGen, and lr_save_timestamp offers more flexible resolution.

args.name: tmstampParam
args.desc: The name of the parameter in which the timestamp is saved.

name: web_convert_param
signature: int web_convert_param( const char *ParamName, [char *SourceString] char *SourceEncoding, char *TargetEncoding, LAST );
description: Converts text between HTML, URL, and plain text encoding formats and saves the result to a parameter. Useful when extracting URLs from HTML documents for use in HTTP requests.

args.name: ParamName
args.desc: The name of the parameter in which the conversion result is saved (also the source if SourceString is absent).

args.name: SourceString
args.desc: Optional: the literal string to convert ("SourceString=...").

args.name: SourceEncoding
args.desc: The source format: HTML, URL, or PLAIN.

args.name: TargetEncoding
args.desc: The target format: HTML, URL, or PLAIN.

name: web_convert_date_param
signature: int web_convert_date_param( const char * SourceParam, [const char * TargetParam,] const char * SourceFormat, const char * TargetFormat, LAST );
description: Converts a date string in a parameter from one format to another; the result replaces the source parameter or is written to a target parameter. The documentation supports only conversion from the "AMERICAN" format to the "GERMAN" format.

args.name: SourceParam
args.desc: The name of the parameter that holds the date string (not a name-value pair).

args.name: TargetParam
args.desc: Optional: the destination parameter for the result; if specified, the source is left unchanged.

args.name: SourceFormat
args.desc: The input date format: "SourceFormat=AMERICAN".

args.name: TargetFormat
args.desc: The output date format: "TargetFormat=GERMAN".

name: web_convert_from_formatted
signature: int web_convert_from_formatted("FormattedData=<formatted_data_string>", "TargetParam=<parameter_name>", ["Extensions=<comma_separated_list_of_extensions>",] LAST );
description: Converts a formatted string (Data Format Extensions) back to its source format and saves it to a parameter. Requires Data Format Extensions to be enabled in the runtime settings.

args.name: FormattedData
args.desc: The string to convert; include the XML wrapper tags if Extensions is not specified.

args.name: TargetParam
args.desc: The name of the parameter in which the result is saved.

args.name: Extensions
args.desc: Optional: a comma-separated list of extensions, in reverse order of application.

args.name: FormattedData/EscapedBinary
args.desc: Qualifier: binary data with escaped character representation.

args.name: FormattedData/BinaryParam
args.desc: Qualifier: a parameter that holds binary data.

example:
web_convert_from_formatted(
    "FormattedData=username=dfe&password=dfe&login.x=17&login.y=8",
    "TargetParam=Param",
    "Extensions=Base64",
    LAST);

name: web_convert_to_formatted
signature: int web_convert_to_formatted ("RawData=<data_string>", "TargetParam=<parameter_name>", "ChainName=<name>", LAST );
description: Applies formatting to raw data through one or more Data Format Extensions (a chain) and saves the result to a parameter. Requires Data Format Extensions to be enabled in the runtime settings.

args.name: RawData
args.desc: The input data to format.

args.name: TargetParam
args.desc: The name of the parameter in which the resulting string is saved.

args.name: ChainName
args.desc: The name of the data format chain (user-defined or built-in) from the chain INI file.

args.name: RawData/EscapedBinary
args.desc: Qualifier: a string with escaped binary codes.

args.name: RawData/BinaryParam
args.desc: Qualifier: a parameter that holds binary data.

example:
web_convert_to_formatted(
    "RawData= {\"firstName\": \"John\",\"lastName\": \"Smith\"}",
    "TargetParam=DFE_Param1",
    "ChainName=myChainName1",
    LAST);

web_convert_to_formatted(
    "RawData/BinaryParam= myBinaryDataBuffer",
    "TargetParam=DFE_Param3",
    "ChainName=MyChainName3",
    LAST);

name: web_sjis_to_euc_param
signature: int web_sjis_to_euc_param(LPCSTR param_name, LPCSTR param_value_in_SJIS);
description: Converts an SJIS (Shift JIS) encoded string to EUC and saves it to a parameter. Applies only to the Japanese edition of VuGen and is supported for all web scripts; both arguments support parameterization.

args.name: param_name
args.desc: The name of the parameter in which the converted value is saved (no spaces).

args.name: param_value_in_SJIS
args.desc: The null-terminated SJIS-encoded string to convert to EUC.

name: web_report_data_point
signature: int web_report_data_point( const char *EventType_, const char *EventName_, const char *DataPointName_, LAST );
description: Defines a data point and includes it in the test results, generally to report step timeouts and other events that appear on the Online graphs in the Controller. All arguments support parameterization.

args.name: EventType
args.desc: The event type; currently supports "EventType=Error".

args.name: EventName
args.desc: The event name; currently supports "EventName=StepTimeOut".

args.name: DataPointName
args.desc: The user-defined data point name.

name: web_reg_add_cookie
signature: int web_reg_add_cookie( const char *cookie, const char *searchstring, LAST );
description: Registers a search for a text string and automatically adds or modifies a cookie when that text appears in the response of the next action function. The domain attribute is required, and this function must be added manually (it is not recorded automatically).

args.name: cookie
args.desc: The cookie definition: <name>=VALUE; domain=DOMAIN_NAME; with the optional expires, path, and secure attributes.

args.name: searchstring
args.desc: The text to search for, in the format "Text=string".

args.name: LAST
args.desc: The required marker for the end of the argument list.

example: web_reg_add_cookie("client_id=RosingsPark127B; path=/; expires=Wednesday, 09-Nov-2011 23:12:40 GMT; domain=www.pemberley.com", "Text=Darcy");

name: web_get_int_property
signature: int web_get_int_property(const int HttpInfoType);
description: Returns specific information about the previous HTTP request, such as the status code, download size and time, or total request/response statistics.

args.name: HTTP_INFO_RETURN_CODE
args.desc: The HTTP response status code.

args.name: HTTP_INFO_DOWNLOAD_SIZE
args.desc: The size of the last download in bytes (headers, body, overhead).

args.name: HTTP_INFO_DOWNLOAD_TIME
args.desc: The download duration in milliseconds.

args.name: HTTP_INFO_LAST_SOCKET_ERROR
args.desc: The last socket error (10060 on timeout).

args.name: HTTP_INFO_TOTAL_REQUEST_STAT
args.desc: The accumulated size of request headers/bodies.

args.name: HTTP_INFO_TOTAL_RESPONSE_STAT
args.desc: The accumulated size of responses.
